column1: # RETRACTED CLAIMS — the fuel for qc/consistency.py
# Every row is a claim that was once written down as a finding and later DISPROVED by measurement.
# The guard fails the build if any of these phrases appears as a live assertion anywhere in
# knowledge/, the skill, the memory or the root docs.
# Quoting a withdrawn claim INSIDE a retraction is correct and expected — the guard allows the
# phrase within 14 lines of a retraction marker (RETRACTED / CORRECTED / WITHDRAWN / CLOSED /
# "used to say" / "used to read" / הופרך / נסגר / תוקן).
# ADD A ROW THE MOMENT YOU RETRACT SOMETHING. That is the whole point: the next person to write
# the old sentence gets stopped by a machine instead of by luck.
#   date        phrase (a distinctive fragment — long enough to be unambiguous)        why it is false
